title: Echo and Colony
author: C. M. Vasquez
blurb: Wren Sandoval, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
